title: KU2D YouTube Operational Hardening & Batch Readiness Campaign v1
objective: Run one long continuous repository-first YouTube operational-hardening campaign after the integrated Q-Diving identity-boundary result. Consolidate the P36 fail-closed evidence, design durable reviewed-video identity governance, harden metadata/comments batch execution contracts, implement checkpoint/resume, quota accounting, idempotency, failure isolation, Deep Audit, batch manifests, KU2D-to-KU2A intake packaging, drift handling, deterministic simulation, tiering, and readiness reporting. Continue across all safe phases without returning control between phases. Any step requiring new human-reviewed video identity, live discovery, broader H11 authority, OAuth/caption access, or production authority must be recorded as a deferred human gate while the remaining offline work continues.
instructions: Perform Branch Handoff Protocol v1 mechanically. Close the current source queue before switching, then create/switch to codex/ku2d-youtube-operational-hardening-batch-readiness-v1 from integration/data-acquisition-platform at exact merge commit 0b2877e6ab86524f4a78771c27600d7eecd5abe8, initialize the target queue as sole authority, and preserve completed history without replay.

Start by inspecting merged P34-P36 artifacts, YouTube v1 foundation, Human Review contracts, Q-Diving registry/profile evidence, YouTube v2 content contracts, identity-boundary validator, relevant historical merged PR evidence, and all existing deterministic tests before editing. Preserve source terminology and do not reinterpret sanitized fixtures as live proof or Human Review authority.

Create a P36 consolidation record/report that states exactly why the live pilot did not start: 0 of 2 durable non-sanitized explicitly Human-Reviewed canonical video identities were available. Preserve request/quota/page counts at zero and keep this distinct from API credential failure, transport failure, comment failure, or YouTube access failure.

Design and implement a durable Reviewed YouTube Video Identity Registry contract. Each entry must support canonical video_id, canonical watch URL derivation, channel identity, title snapshot if available, review record linkage, reviewer authority/provenance, review timestamp, purpose/profile linkage, status, supersession/revocation, privacy classification, source evidence references, and explicit usable_for_live_acquisition flag. A registry entry may become usable only from valid Human Review evidence; Codex must not self-promote candidate identities into reviewed identities.

Add fail-closed identity-registry validators covering duplicate IDs, conflicting channel/video relationships, missing review provenance, sanitized-placeholder IDs, malformed IDs, revoked/superseded entries, ambiguous source linkage, assistant-generated human authority, and attempts to use unreviewed identities for live acquisition.

Audit existing merged repository evidence for any candidate Q-Diving identities that could later be presented for human review, but do not perform live YouTube search/discovery and do not mark any candidate as reviewed. If candidate identities exist only in historical/sanitized context, retain them as candidate-only evidence with explicit provenance and privacy-safe handling; if none exist, report that clearly.

Harden the YouTube metadata batch contract for reviewed-video execution: exact-input-only mode, deterministic videos.list batching, expected/missing video classification, deleted/private/unavailable handling, metadata snapshot typing, channel relationship integrity, duplicate suppression, quota ledger entries, evidence-before-next-request, per-video result state, and no search.list fallback when exact IDs are supplied.

Harden the comments/replies batch contract: commentThreads.list page cap, comments.list only when embedded replies are incomplete and budget permits, stable comment/thread/parent relationship keys, deduplication, edited-comment handling, commentsDisabled/no_comments distinction, deletion/moderation incompleteness, requested ordering provenance, page-token checkpointing without exposing sensitive material, and explicit coverage/truncation indicators. Never infer representativeness, sentiment, popularity, or demand from API ordering or counts.

Implement a storage-neutral quota ledger and bounded budget planner for future public-read YouTube runs. Track method, estimated/documented unit cost, request count, page count, video count, consumed budget, remaining budget, stop reason, and value origin. Exact official quota unit assumptions must cite current official Google/YouTube documentation or be labeled unverified/proposal_not_observed; do not silently rely on stale numbers.

Implement checkpoint/resume and idempotency contracts for multi-video batches. A restart must not rediscover videos, widen scope, repeat already durable pages unnecessarily, change page limits, switch endpoints, or lose evidence. Define deterministic run_id/video checkpoint/page checkpoint semantics, immutable request intent, resume eligibility, and fail-closed behavior for inconsistent checkpoints.

Implement per-video failure isolation and campaign aggregation semantics. One unavailable/disabled/withheld video must not silently abort every other eligible video, but campaign exit 0/2/1 must remain deterministic based on required modules, evidence durability, quota integrity, and Deep Audit. Do not convert optional transcript/comment absence into technical failure unless the manifest marks that module required.

Create a YouTube drift model and drift taxonomy for at least: video_unavailable_or_deleted, privacy/status change, comments_disabled_change, comment pagination behavior change, reply completeness change, metadata field disappearance, channel relationship drift, quota-cost/documentation change, endpoint/response-schema change, language-signal change, transcript/caption authorization boundary change, and evidence/provenance writer failure. Define which drifts allow bounded re-read, which require re-review, and which require new human authority.

Build a deterministic YouTube Batch Manifest v1 contract for reviewed-video inputs. Include exact identity registry references, required/optional modules, allowed endpoints, language scope [th,en], comment page caps, reply policy, request/quota budgets, concurrency, timeout/retry policy, checkpoint/resume, evidence-before-next-request, Deep Audit gates, drift rules, stop conditions, exit meanings, production_store=false, scheduler_action=null, and prohibition on automatic search/discovery/endpoint switching. Numeric workload values unsupported by evidence must be labeled proposal_not_observed.

Prepare both a two-video bounded manifest template compatible with the intended Q-Diving pilot and a larger long-run reviewed-video manifest template for tens/hundreds of videos. The larger template is planning-only and must not include any unreviewed video identity or authorize execution. Provide scaling analysis for request/quota growth, checkpoint frequency, serialization/concurrency, and failure isolation without inventing guaranteed duration or yield.

Create deterministic simulations/fixtures for multi-video scenarios including all-success, one-video unavailable, comments disabled, no comments, partial replies requiring comments.list, page-limit truncation, duplicate pages/comments, edited comment, quota boundary before next page, checkpoint resume, corrupt checkpoint, relationship mismatch, identity revoked after manifest creation, and mixed optional-module outcomes. No live source requests are allowed in these simulations.

Expand Deep Audit for batch operation. Require identity provenance integrity, metadata identity completeness for available videos, timestamped snapshot semantics, comment relationship integrity, pagination/coverage disclosure, quota ledger reconciliation, deterministic checkpoint state, zero unsupported-language transcript text, zero unauthorized caption/OAuth execution, zero representativeness claims, and production_approved=false. Define source/video/module-level audit outputs separately.

Create a storage-neutral KU2D-to-KU2A sample Dataset Intake package from sanitized/offline fixtures only, demonstrating channel/video/comment/reply relationships, acquisition timestamps, publish/update timestamps, module status, completeness/coverage, provenance, and audit fields. Do not perform sentiment, topic, embedding, semantic-search computation, model inference, or any analytics in this queue.

Define YouTube source/video operational tiering such as batch_ready_reviewed_identity, bounded_only, identity_review_required, owner_authorized_caption_required, unavailable_or_withheld, and drift_review_required. Tier assignment must be evidence-based and must not promote any current Q-Diving identity into batch_ready without genuine Human Review provenance.

Produce a Human Gate Register listing every remaining judgment/authority item with exact evidence needed. At minimum include establishment of exactly two Q-Diving reviewed canonical video IDs, any expansion beyond two videos, any live search/discovery, captions.list/download or OAuth owner flow, any public transcript-surface approval, production store/scheduler enablement, authority promotion, and any broader batch execution authorization not already covered by an explicit valid Human Decision.

Where current official Google/YouTube documentation is needed for quota, endpoint, authorization, pagination, or field semantics, official documentation research is permitted. Documentation research is not source acquisition. Record source URL/title/access date or equivalent provenance in documentation/contracts. No YouTube content/API execution is authorized by P37.

Do not make YouTube API/content requests, do not inspect or expose API credentials, do not perform OAuth, captions.list/download, transcript acquisition, browser/Edge activity, HTML scraping, undocumented endpoint calls, proxy/login/CAPTCHA/bypass actions, production writes, scheduler actions, authority promotion, parked-ref mutation, branch cleanup, ML work, Survey/DoE/SEM work, or automatic Learning Memory export.

Add/extend fail-closed validators, deterministic tests, CI coverage, and regression checks. Preserve existing YouTube v1/v2, Q-Diving, Agent Handoff, supermarket, retail, marketplace, coffee, knowledge-quality, governance, and branch-handoff regressions. Do not weaken a validator merely to make a new fixture pass.

Produce a final YouTube Operational Hardening & Batch Readiness Report with: P36 disposition; identity-governance readiness; metadata readiness; comments/replies readiness; quota/checkpoint/idempotency readiness; Deep Audit readiness; KU2A intake readiness; operational tiers; deferred human gates; exact blockers preventing a real Q-Diving rerun; proposed smallest next governed action; and long-run batch readiness limitations.

Open one PR against integration/data-acquisition-platform, keep the queue continuous through all safe phases, perform safe mechanical PR operations including Ready transition only when exact-head CI is green, and do not merge.

Return KU2D-R-000037 with completed_queue_summary containing only important items: work completed; key findings/results; repo/knowledge state changes; important out-of-scope actions not performed; remaining blockers/risks; exact human gates; readiness by module; and recommended next logical step. Clearly distinguish implemented capability from live-validated capability.

completion_behavior.if_phase_blocked: record deferred_human_gate or blocker and continue every remaining offline phase that can be completed safely
